I don't have a record of a specific Saturday class for Mira. A couple of things to know:

- **Google Calendar isn't connected**, so I can't check your schedule. You can link it in Settings and I'll be able to look that up for you going forward.
- **Memory and local activity records** don't have a Saturday class logged either — the parent-and-tot swim class did come up in her recent activities, but no day or enrolment detail was stored.

If you let me know the class name or tell me it's a regular Saturday thing, I can save it so I'll have it next time.
